_comment: Damage reflection, design step 9c (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 14): the KILL FOLD of the main-phase
and combat reflection-target fans. The turn-4 position of the d3/b10 game seed 27 / game-index 26 (Stuffy Doll):
a settled Boros Reckoner, Loran's Escape + Guilty Conscience + Chain Reaction + Spiteful Sliver in hand. Escape
makes the Reckoner indestructible and GC loops it: every one of its reflections is a target choice (the face, itself,
the Sliver, the opponent's creature), and the loop is unbounded until someone dies. Before the folds the fans
cloned the plan once per option at every choice of the loop, i.e. every interleaving: the step-9b binary spent
minutes in AppendSubdecisionAxes (combat fan: SimulateCombat -> CombatDamageDealt -> Drain; main fan: Chain
Reaction -> dmgrx::Sweep -> Drain) with RSS growing without bound, at a 10 ms budget, since enumeration is not
charged. With the folds a line that kills this turn is pinned instead of fanned; the game wins on turn 4 in ~1 s.
